description: Erdurand wears a long burgundy outer tunic patterned with small gold heraldic fleur-like motifs and broad ornate gold embroidered borders at the neck, front, sleeves and hem. A cream linen shirt with an upright split collar and embroidered cuffs shows beneath the shorter outer sleeves. A brown leather belt with a metal buckle and diamond-shaped fittings hangs down the front. Brown fitted trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots. His head and hands are bare; no armor or weapons are visible.
